how_to_use: Companion of docs/HANDOFF.md. Pick the first item with status 'open'. Read only its entry_points with tools/re_helpers.py. When done: set status, add findings to docs (GAMEPLAY_SCENARIO/GAMEPLAY_FLOW), add readings to PSEUDOCODE_READINGS in tools/gameplay_flow.py, rebuild output/gameplay, update docs/HANDOFF.md session log.

items.goal: Find the code that writes the 7 weekly visitor codes and the Celeste weekday int (+0x74) of the 0x78-byte schedule save member.
items.known: Member descriptor 0x33d50a8, save offset +0x20a210. Codes 1 gul, 2 hgc, 3 cml, 5 hgh, 6 bey, 7 chy, 8 skk (0xc6f1a0). Today code = 0xfdc020.
items.method: decomp each candidate; look for writes into param+0..0x1c and +0x74 and calls to RNG 0x19aa0e0/0x19aa110; candidates without callers are vtable slots, find their vtable via binary/code_pointer_arrays.json
items.done_when: Writer identified and the code distribution (which NPC, how often, exclusions) written down.
